Use when drafting corporate governance documents, ethics codes, compliance policies, or business ethics frameworks for public companies or regulated industries.

legal/coding-anesthesia-services.name: coding-anesthesia-services
legal/coding-anesthesia-services.description: Assigns anesthesia codes with time documentation, base/time unit calculation, and physical status modifiers. Use when coding anesthesia, calculating anesthesia units, or applying physical status modifiers.

legal/coding-emergency-services.name: coding-emergency-services
legal/coding-emergency-services.description: Assigns ED-specific E/M codes with critical care time documentation and procedure coding. Use when coding ED visits, documenting critical care, or coding ED procedures.

legal/coding-laboratory-services.name: coding-laboratory-services
legal/coding-laboratory-services.description: Assigns laboratory CPT codes with panel construction and specimen-specific modifiers. Use when coding lab tests, building lab panels, or applying laboratory modifiers.

legal/coding-radiology-services.name: coding-radiology-services
legal/coding-radiology-services.description: Assigns radiology CPT codes with professional/technical component and supervision level documentation. Use when coding imaging studies, applying 26/TC modifiers, or coding interventional procedures.

legal/cognovit-note.name: cognovit-note
legal/cognovit-note.description: Drafts cognovit promissory notes with confession of judgment provisions, gated by mandatory jurisdictional enforceability research, usury compliance, and statutory disclosure requirements. Advises on alternatives where cognovit clauses are prohibited. Use when drafting cognovit notes, confession of judgment instruments, or loan documents requiring waiver-of-defense provisions.

legal/coi-compliance-review.name: coi-compliance-review
legal/coi-compliance-review.description: Reviews CRE insurance certificates (ACORD 25) and endorsements against Access Agreement insurance requirements, producing a pass/fail compliance determination with broker-ready deficiency instructions. Use when reviewing COIs, ACORD forms, vendor or contractor insurance, site access insurance, or Additional Insured endorsements in commercial real estate transactions.

legal/collateral-assignment-of-contracts.name: collateral-assignment-of-contracts
legal/collateral-assignment-of-contracts.description: Drafts a Collateral Assignment of Contracts assigning a borrower's contractual rights as security for debt under UCC Article 9. legal/comfort-letter-from-auditors.name: comfort-letter-from-auditors
legal/comfort-letter-from-auditors.description: Drafts PCAOB AS 6101-compliant auditor comfort letters (cold comfort letters) providing negative assurance on unaudited financial information for underwriters in U.S. securities offerings. Use when drafting comfort letters for underwriting agreements, capital markets closings, IPOs, secondary offerings, or any securities transaction requiring auditor negative assurance at signing or closing.

legal/commencement-date-memo.name: commencement-date-memo
legal/commencement-date-memo.description: Drafts a Commencement Date Memorandum confirming when obligations take effect under an executed agreement. Triggers when formalizing lease commencement dates, documenting condition-precedent satisfaction, or recording the effective date of contractual obligations post-execution.

legal/commencement-date-memorandum.name: commencement-date-memorandum
legal/commencement-date-memorandum.description: Drafts a U.S. commencement-date memorandum for commercial leases and related agreements, confirming the operative start date and its evidentiary basis. Use when users request a defensible record of "commencement date," "effective date," "lease start," conditions precedent satisfaction, or timing of rent, termination, or performance triggers — typically after execution, at closing, or during post-signature administration.

legal/commercial-invoice-for-export.name: commercial-invoice-for-export
legal/commercial-invoice-for-export.description: Drafts a compliant Commercial Invoice for Export satisfying customs, banking (L/C), logistics, and insurance requirements. Enforces Incoterms 2020, HS tariff classification, country-of-origin determination, export control referencing, and certification language. Use when preparing export invoices for customs authorities, freight forwarders, banks, or insurance underwriters.

legal/commercial-promissory-note.name: commercial-promissory-note
legal/commercial-promissory-note.description: Drafts UCC-compliant U.S. Commercial Promissory Notes for commercial real estate finance transactions. Produces negotiable instruments with principal, interest, payment, default, and enforcement provisions protecting lender interests. Use when drafting promissory notes secured by real property, deed of trust, or mortgage in commercial lending.

legal/commercial-psa.name: commercial-psa
legal/commercial-psa.description: Drafts Purchase and Sale Agreements for commercial real estate transactions (office, retail, industrial, multifamily). Triggers when the user needs a commercial PSA, purchase agreement, sale contract, or acquisition agreement. Extracts deal terms from uploaded documents and structures all major provisions.

optical-engineering/fiber-optics.name: fiber-optics

optical-engineering/imaging-systems.name: imaging-systems
optical-engineering/imaging-systems.description: Digital Imaging & Sensor Integration: CMOS/CCD quantum efficiency, spatial resolution (Nyquist criterion), pixel crosstalk, lens-sensor matching, and radiometric calibration.

optical-engineering/interferometry.name: interferometry
optical-engineering/interferometry.description: Precision Optical Interferometry: Michelson, Mach-Zehnder, and Fabry-Pérot configurations, fringe analysis, phase-shifting interferometry, and sub-nanometer metrology.

optical-engineering/ja.name: ja
optical-engineering/ja.description: 測定要件、2D 光路図、出所を記録した CAD から新しい測定光路を設計し、Blender 光学システムを再構築・監査・改訂します。高精細 optics-only モデル、Thorlabs 互換光機部品、光路 topology、全系検証、証拠範囲を明示した出版用レンダーに使用します。

optical-engineering/laser-systems.name: laser-systems
optical-engineering/laser-systems.description: Laser Cavity Design & Beam Propagation: Gaussian beam waist propagation ($M^2$ parameter), laser diode drivers, resonator stability criteria, and thermal lensing compensation.

optical-engineering/lens-design.name: lens-design
optical-engineering/lens-design.description: Lens Prescription & Optimization: Doublet/triplet design, telephoto lenses, aspheric surface coefficients, glass map selection, and chromatic aberration nulling.

optical-engineering/lidar.name: lidar
optical-engineering/lidar.description: LiDAR System Architecture & Point Cloud Sensing: Time-of-flight (ToF) and FMCW ranging equations, laser safety (IEC 60825-1 Class 1), scanner mechanics, and SNR budget.

optical-engineering/optical-coatings.name: optical-coatings
optical-engineering/optical-coatings.description: Thin-Film Optical Coatings & Filters: Multilayer dielectric interference coatings, anti-reflective (AR) coatings, high-reflection dielectric mirrors, and bandpass design.

optical-engineering/optical-communicatio.name: optical-communications
optical-engineering/optical-communicatio.description: Coherent Optical Telecommunication: WDM/DWDM multiplexing, QPSK/16-QAM modulation, erbium-doped fiber amplifiers (EDFA), and optical SNR calculations.

optical-engineering/optical-design.name: optical-design
optical-engineering/optical-design.description: Geometric & Physical Optical System Design: Ray tracing algorithms, aberration theory (Seidel/Zernike), modulation transfer function (MTF), and Petzval curvature correction.

optical-engineering/optical-testing.name: optical-testing
optical-engineering/optical-testing.description: Optical Metrology & Surface Characterization: Wavefront sensing (Shack-Hartmann), interferometric surface profiling, ISO 10110 drawing standards, and scratch-dig inspection.

optical-engineering/optomechanics.name: optomechanics
optical-engineering/optomechanics.description: Precision Optomechanical Mounting: Kinematic mount constraints, thermal expansion matching (CTE), adhesive bonding of optics, barrel tolerancing, and vibration isolation.

optical-engineering/photonics.name: photonics
optical-engineering/photonics.description: Integrated Photonic Circuits & Nanophotonics: Silicon photonics waveguides, Mach-Zehnder modulators, ring resonators, grating couplers, and photonic crystal bandgaps.

optical-engineering/spectroscopy.name: spectroscopy
optical-engineering/spectroscopy.description: Optical Spectroscopy & Spectral Analysis: Diffraction grating equation, Fourier transform infrared (FTIR), Raman scattering, monochromators, and spectral resolution calculation.

optical-engineering/thorlabs-blender-opt.name: thorlabs-blender-optical-path

Use for high-fidelity optics-only models, Thorlabs-compatible optomechanics, optical topology, whole-system validation, or publication renders with scoped physical evidence.

optical-engineering/zh-cn.name: zh-cn

optometry/binocular-vision.name: binocular-vision
optometry/binocular-vision.description: Binocular Vision & Ocular Motility Evaluation: Cover-uncover and alternating cover tests, prism bar dissociation, near point of convergence (NPC), stereopsis (Titmus/Randot), and phoria vs tropia.

optometry/contact-lenses.name: contact-lenses
optometry/contact-lenses.description: Contact Lens Fitting & Corneal Assessment: Keratometry/topography, base curve and diameter selection, soft vs rigid gas permeable (RGP) lenses, toric stabilization, and slit-lamp fluorescein evaluation.

optometry/eye-examination.name: eye-examination
optometry/eye-examination.description: Comprehensive Clinical Eye Examination: Systematic ophthalmic workup: patient history, visual acuity, slit-lamp biomicroscopy, intraocular pressure (tonometry), and dilated fundoscopy.

optometry/glaucoma-screening.name: glaucoma-screening
optometry/glaucoma-screening.description: Glaucoma Diagnostic Evaluation & Staging: Goldmann applanation tonometry (GAT), pachymetry corneal thickness correction, gonioscopy angle grading (Shaffer system), and optical coherence tomography (OCT) RNFL analysis.

optometry/low-vision.name: low-vision
optometry/low-vision.description: Low Vision Rehabilitation & Assistive Optics: Magnification power calculations ($M = F/4$), optical low vision aids (telescopes, hand/stand magnifiers), electronic video magnifiers, and lighting optimization.

optometry/ocular-disease.name: ocular-disease
optometry/ocular-disease.description: Anterior & Posterior Segment Pathology Diagnosis: Blepharitis, keratoconjunctivitis, cataract grading (LOCS III), diabetic retinopathy screening (ETDRS classification), and macular degeneration.

optometry/optical-dispensing.name: optical-dispensing
optometry/optical-dispensing.description: Ophthalmic Lens Dispensing & Frame Styling: Pupillary distance (PD) measurement, seg height alignment for progressives, lens materials (CR-39, polycarbonate, high-index), and anti-reflective/photochromic treatments.

optometry/pediatric-optometry.name: pediatric-optometry
optometry/pediatric-optometry.description: Pediatric Visual Development & Amblyopia: Preferential looking tests (Teller acuity cards), cycloplegic refraction, strabismus detection, amblyopia patching regimens, and refractive error tracking.

optometry/refraction.name: refraction
optometry/refraction.description: Objective & Subjective Clinical Refraction: Retinoscopy, automated refractometry, Jackson cross-cylinder astigmatism refinement, spherical equivalent, and binocular balancing.

optometry/retinal-assessment.name: retinal-assessment
optometry/retinal-assessment.description: Retinal Imaging & Fundus Biomicroscopy: Non-mydriatic fundus photography, OCT retinal thickness maps, fluorescein angiography interpretation, and retinal detachment emergency referral.

optometry/visual-acuity.name: visual-acuity
optometry/visual-acuity.description: Standardized Visual Acuity Assessment: Snellen, LogMAR, and ETDRS visual acuity charts, pinhole visual acuity testing, contrast sensitivity testing (Pelli-Robson), and low vision charting.

petroleum-engineering/completion-enginee.name: completion-engineering
petroleum-engineering/completion-enginee.description: Well Completion & Hydraulic Fracturing: Casing design, perforation spacing, multistage plug-and-perf fracturing, proppant transport mechanics, and sand screen placement.

petroleum-engineering/drilling-engineeri.name: drilling-engineering
petroleum-engineering/drilling-engineeri.description: Well Drilling Mechanics & Hydraulics: BHA (Bottom Hole Assembly) design, directional drilling/MWD, drill bit hydraulics ($HSI$), mud circulation, and well control/BOP.

petroleum-engineering/enhanced-oil-recov.name: enhanced-oil-recovery
petroleum-engineering/enhanced-oil-recov.description: Tertiary Recovery (EOR) Mechanisms: Miscible gas injection ($CO_2$/hydrocarbon), polymer/surfactant flooding, steam-assisted gravity drainage (SAGD), and capillary desaturation.

petroleum-engineering/lng.name: lng
petroleum-engineering/lng.description: Liquefied Natural Gas Processing & Cryogenics: Acid gas removal (MDEA), propane precooled mixed refrigerant (C3MR) cycle, LNG storage tanks, and boil-off gas (BOG) re-liquefaction.

petroleum-engineering/offshore-oil.name: offshore-oil
petroleum-engineering/offshore-oil.description: Subsea & Floating Offshore Production Systems: FPSO and TLP mooring dynamics, subsea trees, subsea tiebacks, riser slugging control, and deepwater blowout prevention.

petroleum-engineering/petroleum-economic.name: petroleum-economics
petroleum-engineering/petroleum-economic.description: Upstream Asset Valuation & Fiscal Regimes: Discounted cash flow (DCF), net present value (NPV), IRR, production sharing contracts (PSC), concession royalties, and reserve booking.

petroleum-engineering/petrophysics.name: petrophysics
petroleum-engineering/petrophysics.description: Core Analysis & Rock-Fluid Properties: Capillary pressure curves, relative permeability ($k_{ro}, k_{rw}$), wettability indices, and NMR pore size distribution.

petroleum-engineering/production-enginee.name: production-engineering
petroleum-engineering/production-enginee.description: Well Inflow & Artificial Lift Optimization: Inflow Performance Relationship (IPR) vs Outflow (VLP), electrical submersible pumps (ESP), gas lift design, and nodal analysis.

petroleum-engineering/production-optimiz.name: production-optimization
petroleum-engineering/production-optimiz.description: Field Flowline & Network Debottlenecking: Multiphase flow regimes (Beggs-Brill), hydrate prevention/MEG injection, emulsion treating, and gas-oil separation plant (GOSP) balancing.

petroleum-engineering/reservoir-engineer.name: reservoir-engineering
petroleum-engineering/reservoir-engineer.description: Hydrocarbon Reservoir Characterization: Material balance equations (Havlena-Odeh), Darcy flow in porous media, PVT fluid phase behavior, and recovery factor calculation.

petroleum-engineering/reservoir-simulati.name: reservoir-simulation
petroleum-engineering/reservoir-simulati.description: Numerical Black-Oil & Compositional Modeling: Finite-difference reservoir grid blocks, IMPES vs fully implicit schemes, history matching, and forward production forecasting.

petroleum-engineering/well-logging.name: well-logging
petroleum-engineering/well-logging.description: Petrophysical Log Interpretation: Gamma ray lithology, resistivity log water saturation (Archie equation), neutron-density porosity, and sonic transit time.

petroleum-engineering/well-testing.name: well-testing
petroleum-engineering/well-testing.description: Pressure Transient Analysis (PTA): Horner plots, pressure buildup/drawdown analysis, skin factor ($s$), reservoir permeability ($k$), and drainage boundary detection.

systems-engineering/system-architecture.description: System Architecture & Functional Decomposition: Physical, logical, and functional views (DoDAF/UAF), subsystem boundary encapsulation, and architectural tradeoff analysis.

systems-engineering/systems-integration.description: System Integration & Assembly Sequencing: Bottom-up and continuous integration strategies, harness testing, mock hardware-in-the-loop (HIL) fixtures, and smoke checks.

systems-engineering/systems-optimization.description: System Multi-Objective Parameter Optimization: Pareto frontier analysis, design of experiments (DOE), multidisciplinary design optimization (MDO), and throughput maximization.

systems-networking/linux-internals.name: linux-internals
systems-networking/linux-internals.description: Linux Kernel Subsystems & Core Mechanics: Task structs, process scheduler (CFS - Completely Fair Scheduler), virtual memory management (VMA, page tables, page faults), VFS (Virtual File System), and loadable kernel modules.

systems-networking/macos-internals.name: macos-internals

systems-networking/network-programming.name: network-programming

systems-networking/networking-fundamenta.name: networking-fundamentals

systems-networking/operating-systems.name: operating-systems
systems-networking/operating-systems.description: OS Kernel Architectures & Subsystems: Monolithic vs microkernels, user vs supervisor mode transitions, interrupt service routines (ISR), system call dispatch tables, and POSIX compliance.

systems-networking/routing-protocols.name: routing-protocols
systems-networking/routing-protocols.description: Dynamic IP Routing & Interior/Exterior Gateways: Border Gateway Protocol (BGP-4), Open Shortest Path First (OSPF v2/v3), IS-IS, route redistribution, Autonomous System (AS) path attributes, and CIDR prefix aggregation.

systems-networking/switching-vlans.name: switching-vlans
systems-networking/switching-vlans.description: Ethernet Switching & Virtual LAN Architecture: CAM tables, Spanning Tree Protocol (STP / RSTP 802.1w), 802.1Q VLAN tagging, trunk ports, Link Aggregation (LACP 802.3ad), and frame switching latency.

systems-networking/system-administration.name: system-administration
systems-networking/system-administration.description: Production Linux/Unix System Administration: systemd unit management, journald logging, PAM authentication modules, SSH hardening, user/group ACLs, cron automation, and disk quota enforcement.

systems-networking/tcp-ip.name: tcp-ip
systems-networking/tcp-ip.description: TCP/IP Protocol Stack & Flow Control: TCP 3-way handshake, 4-way teardown, sliding window flow control, congestion control algorithms (Reno, Cubic, BBR), duplicate ACKs, and TCP reset flags.

systems-networking/tls-cryptography.name: tls-cryptography
systems-networking/tls-cryptography.description: Transport Layer Security (TLS 1.3) Handshake: Diffie-Hellman ephemeral key exchange (ECDHE), X.509 certificate chains, ALPN negotiation, symmetric AEAD ciphers (AES-GCM, ChaCha20-Poly1305), and forward secrecy.

systems-networking/virtualization-hyperv.name: virtualization-hypervisors
systems-networking/virtualization-hyperv.description: Type-1/Type-2 Hypervisors & Hardware Virtualization: Intel VT-x / AMD-V hardware virtualization extensions, Extended Page Tables (EPT), KVM (Kernel-based Virtual Machine), QEMU emulation, and SR-IOV device pass-through.

systems-networking/vpn-technologies.name: vpn-technologies

systems-networking/windows-internals.name: windows-internals
systems-networking/windows-internals.description: Windows NT Kernel & Driver Architecture: NT Executive, HAL (Hardware Abstraction Layer), I/O Request Packets (IRP), Object Manager, Windows Registry architecture, and Windows Filtering Platform (WFP).

systems-networking/wireless-networking.name: wireless-networking

tax/bio-microbiome-taxonomy-assignment.name: bio-microbiome-taxonomy-assignment
tax/bio-microbiome-taxonomy-assignment.description: Assigns taxonomy to amplicon ASVs/OTUs (16S, ITS, 18S) with a classifier conditioned on a reference database and primer region - DADA2 assignTaxonomy + addSpecies (RDP naive Bayes), DECIPHER IDTAXA, and QIIME2 q2-feature-classifier (classify-sklearn naive Bayes, classify-consensus-vsearch alignment-consensus). Covers region-specific training (extract-reads, fit-classifier-naive-bayes), why a full-length classifier fabricates calls on a V4 read, the scikit-learn version-pinning trap on pre-trained .qza classifiers, confidence thresholds (classify-sklearn 0.7, assignTaxonomy minBoot 50), and choosing SILVA/GTDB/Greengenes2/UNITE/PR2/RDP. Use when classifying ASVs after DADA2, picking a reference database, training a region-matched classifier, setting a confidence threshold, or deciding whether a 16S species call is defensible (usually not - genus at best). For shotgun read classification see metagenomics/kraken-classification and metagenomics/metaphlan-profiling.
